name: Vigenere
description: Shifts letters using a repeating key word.
legacyScript: function animate(env,el,p){ var ks=[Math.round(p.k1),Math.round(p.k2)],j=0; el.text=el.text.replace(/[a-z]/gi,function(c){ var b=c<="Z"?65:97; var s=ks[j%ks.length]; j++; return String.fromCharCode((c.charCodeAt(0)-b+s)%26+b); }); return el; }
